content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Note: Only candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may submit the online application. Applications and fee payment will be accepted strictly between 17.08.2026 (afternoon) and 31.08.2026.

rows.event: Online Application & Fee Payment Last Date

content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Papers & Subjects
content_sections.text: STET 2026 is held for two separate papers based on teaching level. Candidates may apply for either paper or both, subject to eligibility. A separate category for Special School Teacher (Divyang/Special Education) is also notified under Paper-I, with distinct qualification norms as per National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) guidelines. Note: Multi Media & Web Technology under Paper-II is applicable only where this subject is taught at the school level; candidates need not qualify separately in it for general eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Separate detailed qualification norms (Parishisht-1 for Paper-I and Parishisht-2 for Paper-II) apply for Physical Education, Music, Fine Arts, Dance, and Special School Teacher categories, including sports-quota and NCC-linked pathways. Candidates should verify the exact clause applicable to their subject in the official notification. The candidate must be a citizen of India. Important: Any dispute regarding recognition of a qualification/institution, or equivalence of a degree, will be decided by the Department in consultation with the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), and that decision will be final.

rows.minimum_requirement_general_subjects: Graduation with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject/subject group from a recognized university, along with a B.Ed. (or equivalent) from an NCTE-recognized institution. Relaxed norms (45% + B.Ed.) apply where prescribed under NCTE Regulations 2002/2007.

Post-graduation with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject from a recognized university, along with a B.Ed. (or equivalent) from an NCTE-recognized institution. Relaxed norms (45% + B.Ed., or 55% + integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.) apply as prescribed.

content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age (all candidates): 21 years as on 01.08.2026. Important: No relaxation in maximum age limit is available to any category for candidates who were already trained/appointed prior to earlier STET cycles (2019, 2024, 2025).

rows.relaxation: 10 years, as per General Administration Department resolution dated 22.01.2021
Actual service period + 3 years, as per GAD circular dated 02.04.2013 (age at application must not exceed 57 years)

content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Exam Fee & Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: Fee is payable online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI. No other mode of fee payment is accepted. Note: Reservation benefits in age, qualifying marks, and fee are applicable only to candidates who are original/permanent residents of Bihar. Candidates domiciled outside Bihar will be treated as General category (male/female) and must pay the fee applicable to the General category. The STET 2026 qualifying certificate will have lifetime validity , as per Departmental Order dated 22.06.2021.

rows.category: General / EWS / Backward Class / Extremely Backward Class

content_sections.heading: Bihar STET 2026 Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Exam duration: 2 hours 30 minutes per paper. Question type: Objective/Multiple-choice, delivered via Computer Based Test (CBT). No negative marking for wrong answers. Since the exam is held across multiple shifts/sittings, a Normalization method is applied to the raw score to ensure candidates are not disadvantaged or advantaged by shift-wise difficulty variation; the final result is based on the Normalized Score, not the Raw Score.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bihar STET 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official portal stetregistration.cbrt.co.in . Complete first-time Registration to generate a User ID and Password (sent via SMS/e-mail). Log in and fill the application form, entering personal, educational, and category details accurately. Upload a recent color photograph (20 KB–200 KB, size 3.5cm × 4.5cm) and scanned signature (10 KB–50 KB). Click "Preview" to verify all entered details before submission; use "Save" to correct any errors. Pay the requisite examination fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI, using the Payment Gateway. Click "Submit" to finalize the application. No changes are permitted after final submission. Download and print a copy of the confirmed application for future reference. Important: Applications must be filled by the candidate personally. Incomplete applications, or more than one application from the same candidate, will be rejected/cancelled. Applications must be filled only in English; use of CAPITAL LETTERS in the declaration/signature section is not permitted. No mode other than online will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matric (10th) certificate and marksheet (for date of birth) Intermediate (12th) certificate and marksheet Graduation certificate and marksheet Post-graduation certificate and marksheet (for Paper-II) B.Ed. certificate and marksheet Any other relevant educational qualification proof Residence certificate issued by a competent authority Caste certificate for SC/ST candidates, issued by a competent authority Creamy-layer-free certificate for Backward Class/Extremely Backward Class candidates, issued by a competent authority Disability certificate, where applicable Ex-servicemen discharge/service documents, where applicable Recent scanned photograph and signature in prescribed format/size

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates should download the application draft first, fill it carefully with a pen, then transcribe the details online, to avoid entry errors. The admit card will be generated strictly based on the details filled in the online application; no correction request will be entertained once the admit card is issued. Candidates must keep their User ID and Password confidential and not share them with anyone, including cyber café operators. If the qualification/subject group mentioned in the application does not match the notified eligibility, the candidature and result may be cancelled at any stage. Candidates applying for the EWS category for STET 2026 must correctly mark "General" as their category in the online application (a common error was noted where EBC candidates mistakenly selected EWS). Result and admit card will be prepared based on the reservation category marked by the candidate in the application; candidates should exercise care while marking the category. Applications with the prescribed fee received after the last date will not be accepted, and such incomplete applications will be rejected. Passing the STET examination does not itself confer any right to appointment. The Samiti reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment/examination process at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bihar STET 2026?
Q2. What is the age limit for STET 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum 21 years as on 01.08.2026; maximum age ranges from 37 to 42 years depending on category, with additional relaxation for Divyang and ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the exam fee?
faq.answer: ₹960 (one paper) / ₹1,440 (both papers) for General/EWS/BC/EBC candidates; ₹760 (one paper) / ₹1,140 (both papers) for SC/ST/Divyang candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: A CBT-based objective exam of 150 marks (100 for subject content, 50 for teaching aptitude), 2 hours 30 minutes duration, no negative marking.

faq.question: Q5. Is the STET certificate valid for a lifetime?
faq.answer: Yes, the STET 2026 qualifying certificate carries lifetime validity as per the Departmental Order dated 22.06.2021.
